description: Knowledge graph schema for the Account Success Spine Domain. Defines all canonical Spine entities, Dynamic Memory types, and their typed relationships as a graph schema consumed by the Projection Engine, Knowledge Service, and Vector Search index.

nodes.name: Account
nodes.description: A paying customer relationship. Not a CRM account — a real-world commercial relationship with recurring value.
nodes.summary_template: {{name}} is a {{tier}} account in the {{industry}} industry, region {{region}}, with ${{arr_usd}} ARR. Contract runs {{contract_start}} to {{contract_end}}.

nodes.name: Person
nodes.description: A human being involved in the customer relationship. Not a CRM contact — a real person with roles, influence, and engagement history.
nodes.summary_template: {{name}} ({{email}}) is a {{seniority}} {{role}} in {{department}}.

nodes.name: Organization
nodes.description: A legal entity that may own one or more Accounts. The parent company, subsidiary, or holding structure.
nodes.summary_template: {{name}} is a {{size}} {{type}} organization in the {{industry}} industry, based in {{region}}.

nodes.name: Contract
nodes.description: A legally binding agreement between the vendor and the customer. Defines terms, value, and duration.
nodes.summary_template: Contract {{name}} ({{type}}) valued at ${{value_usd}}, status {{status}}, valid {{start_date}} to {{end_date}}.

nodes.name: Subscription
nodes.description: A recurring billing commitment. Represents the ongoing commercial relationship with a specific product and terms.
nodes.summary_template: Subscription for product {{product_id}} with ${{mrr_usd}} MRR, status {{status}}, billing {{billing_period}}, quantity {{quantity}}.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.description: A thing the company sells. A SKU, service offering, or platform capability that customers subscribe to or deploy.
nodes.summary_template: Product {{name}} ({{sku}}) in category {{category}}: {{description}}

nodes.name: Deployment
nodes.description: An installed instance of a product. A running system that consumes resources and produces telemetry.
nodes.summary_template: Deployment of product {{product_id}} in environment {{environment_id}}, version {{version_deployed}}, status {{status}}, region {{region}}.

nodes.name: Integration
nodes.description: A connection between systems. An API integration, data sync, or external system link that the customer has configured.
nodes.summary_template: Integration {{name}} ({{type}}) connects {{from_system}} to {{to_system}} via {{protocol}}, status {{status}}.

nodes.name: Environment
nodes.description: A runtime boundary such as production, staging, or development. Where deployments run.
nodes.summary_template: Environment {{name}} ({{type}}) in region {{region}}, provided by {{provider}}, status {{status}}.

nodes.name: Meeting
nodes.description: A synchronous interaction between people. A scheduled call, QBR, workshop, or ad-hoc conversation.
nodes.summary_template: Meeting '{{title}}' ({{type}}) scheduled {{start_time}} to {{end_time}}, status {{status}}, location {{location}}.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.description: A unit of work assigned to a person. A todo, action item, or project task with status and deadline.
nodes.summary_template: Task '{{title}}' with priority {{priority}}, status {{status}}, due {{due_date}}. Description: {{description}}

nodes.name: Objective
nodes.description: A stated goal such as an OKR or MBO. What the customer wants to achieve with the platform.
nodes.summary_template: Objective '{{title}}' ({{type}}), status {{status}}, target {{target_date}}, progress {{progress_percent}}%. {{description}}

nodes.name: Initiative
nodes.description: A program of work to achieve an objective. A project, rollout, or implementation plan with timeline and resources.
nodes.summary_template: Initiative '{{title}}', status {{status}}, running {{start_date}} to {{end_date}}, owner {{owner_id}}, progress {{progress_percent}}%. {{description}}

nodes.name: Health
nodes.description: Account health score and reasoning. Derived from usage, support, engagement, and NPS signals. Ephemeral; TTL 7 days.
nodes.summary_template: Health for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{score}} ({{score_label}}). {{reasoning}}

nodes.name: Risk
nodes.description: Risk score and reasoning for an account or entity. Derived from contract, usage trends, stakeholder changes, and market signals. Ephemeral; TTL 14 days.
nodes.summary_template: Risk for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{score}} ({{score_label}}). {{reasoning}}

nodes.name: Sentiment
nodes.description: Emotional tone of the relationship. Derived from engagement transcripts, emails, and support interactions. Ephemeral; TTL 7 days.
nodes.summary_template: Sentiment for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{score}} ({{score_label}}). {{reasoning}}

nodes.name: Signals
nodes.description: Detected changes or anomalies. Derived from telemetry, webhooks, and delta detection. Ephemeral; TTL 1 day.
nodes.summary_template: Signal detected for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{signal_type}} (severity {{severity}}) from {{source}}. {{description}}

nodes.name: Usage
nodes.description: Aggregated consumption patterns. Derived from telemetry, API logs, and product analytics. Ephemeral; TTL 30 days.
nodes.summary_template: Usage for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{metric_name}} = {{current_value}} (target {{target_value}}), trend {{trend}} over period {{period_start}} to {{period_end}}.

nodes.name: Architecture Assessment
nodes.description: Evaluated architecture posture. Derived from API inventory, deployment topology, and integration map. Ephemeral; TTL 90 days.
nodes.summary_template: Architecture Assessment for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: overall score {{overall_score}}. Findings: {{findings}} Recommendations: {{recommendations}}

nodes.name: Technical Debt
nodes.description: Known technical liabilities. Derived from support tickets, incident post-mortems, and architecture reviews. Ephemeral; TTL 30 days.
nodes.summary_template: Technical Debt for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: severity {{severity}}, impact {{impact}}. Remediation: {{remediation_plan}} (effort {{estimated_effort}}).

nodes.name: Business Context
nodes.description: Synthesized understanding of the customer's business. Derived from public data, earnings calls, news, and CRM notes. Ephemeral; TTL 30 days.
nodes.summary_template: Business Context for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{summary}} Market position: {{market_position}}. Recent changes: {{recent_changes}}.

nodes.name: Engagement
nodes.description: Relationship interaction history. Derived from meetings, emails, calls, and support tickets. Ephemeral; TTL 30 days.
nodes.summary_template: Engagement for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: frequency {{frequency}}, recency {{recency}}, depth {{depth}}. Channels: {{channels}}.

nodes.name: Stakeholder Intelligence
nodes.description: Who matters and why. Derived from org chart, engagement frequency, and decision influence. Ephemeral; TTL 14 days.
nodes.summary_template: Stakeholder Intelligence for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: key stakeholders {{key_stakeholders}}, decision makers {{decision_makers}}.

nodes.name: Recommendations
nodes.description: Suggested actions for the account team. Derived from Health, Risk, Engagement, and Objectives. Ephemeral; TTL 7 days.
nodes.summary_template: Recommendation for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{action}} (priority {{priority}}). Expected impact: {{expected_impact}}. Rationale: {{rationale}}

nodes.name: Insights
nodes.description: Generated findings from cross-signal synthesis and pattern detection. Ephemeral; TTL 7 days.
nodes.summary_template: Insight for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{insight_type}} — {{description}}. Confidence: {{confidence}}.

nodes.name: Evidence
nodes.description: Supporting data for claims. Links, metrics, quotes, and snapshots that back up memories. Persistent while linked to a claim.
nodes.summary_template: Evidence for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: claim '{{claim}}' supported by {{supporting_data}} from {{source}}.

nodes.name: Timeline
nodes.description: Projected events and milestones. Derived from contracts, renewals, initiatives, and go-lives. Ephemeral; TTL 90 days.
nodes.summary_template: Timeline for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: events {{events}}, milestones {{milestones}}, projected dates {{projected_dates}}.

nodes.name: Forecast
nodes.description: Predicted revenue, churn, or expansion. Derived from ML model and historical patterns. Ephemeral; TTL 30 days.
nodes.summary_template: Forecast for {{entity_type}} {{canonical_id}}: {{metric}} = {{value}} over horizon {{horizon}} (model {{model_version}}).

edges.description: An Account owns one or more Contracts.
An Account has one or more Subscriptions.
An Account deploys products into environments.
An Account belongs to an Organization.
A Person works for an Organization.
A Person is assigned to a Task.
A Person is associated with an Account.
An Organization has one or more Accounts.
A Contract covers one or more Products.
A Contract renews into a Subscription.
A Subscription is for a Product.
A Product is deployed as a Deployment.
A Deployment runs in an Environment.
An Integration connects to a Product.
An Objective is part of an Initiative.
An Initiative drives value for an Account.
A Meeting is about an Account.
A Task is for an Account.
An Account has a Health memory (computed state).
An Account has a Risk memory (computed state).
An Account has a Sentiment memory (computed state).
An Account has an Architecture Assessment.
An Account has Technical Debt memory.
An Account has Business Context memory.
An Account has Evidence supporting claims.
An Account has a Timeline memory.
Stakeholder Intelligence is about a Person.
Technical Debt is in a Deployment.
Architecture Assessment is of a Deployment.
